lines.text: The kettle hums while the morning climbs the wall
I count my steps to the old blue chair
Nobody calls, so the quiet stays small
A paper boat rides the puddle by the gate
I whistle one note and watch it drift
Tomorrow can wait while the tea is warm

note: t0/t1 are sample-exact positions where each synthesized line was placed (speech edges, +-0.01 s pad). Regenerating may move times slightly if Kokoro output differs.
